town_description: Fazilka is the district headquarters town in southwestern Punjab, near the India-Pakistan border. A border-market town in the Malwa region, it sits on NH-7/NH-10 with its own railway junction (FKA); nearby attractions include the Abohar blackbuck sanctuary and the Sadqi border retreat ceremony.

travel.airport: Bathinda Airport (BUP), about 90-95 km; Amritsar international airport, about 190-210 km (incredibleindia.gov.in / fazilka.nic.in).
travel.railway: Fazilka Junction (FKA) - well connected within Punjab (incredibleindia.gov.in).
travel.road: NH-7 and NH-10 link Fazilka to Firozpur, Bathinda, Abohar and Delhi; regular state and private buses (incredibleindia.gov.in).
